description: Default services and capabilities derived from per-agent fields in agents.json. agents.json should carry only flags (role, enabled, integrations) — never derived data. Per-agent overrides under capabilities/services win.

comments.role_is_exclusive: Every agent has exactly one role — `coding` or `monitor`. Never both. Coding agents modify code and work tickets; monitor agents triage incidents, wake/restart other agents, send alerts. The boundary is deliberate: different model tunings, different sudoers, different telegram bots, different operational guardrails.
merge_algorithm: 3. For each integration k where agent.integrations[k] is true, merge in byIntegration[k].{services, capabilities}.
4. Per-agent agent.services is APPENDED to the derived services list and de-duplicated. Useful for project-specific extras.
5. Per-agent agent.capabilities OVERRIDES the derived capabilities key-by-key. Useful for read-only / maintenance modes.
6. Result: the effective agent view consumers (ai-monitor, agent-dashboard, openclaw-integrity-check) use.
comments.turning_things_off: Take an agent fully offline: enabled=false. Disable a single capability for maintenance: capabilities: { can_modify_code: false }. Disable an integration: integrations.gmail=false (removes the listener service and the can_send_email cap together).
comments.per_project_extensions: Per-project add-ons (extra services to watch, listener ports for a side project) should live in ~/<user>/.config/openclaw/projects/<name>.json and be merged dynamically by the loader. Convention documented but not implemented — wait for a real project to need it. Goal: keep this central registry free of project data that comes and goes.

core._doc: Applied to every enabled agent regardless of role. The openclaw gateway is the runtime every agent needs.

coding._doc: Coding agents work Jira tickets, modify code, push branches. Never participate in monitoring.

monitor._doc: Monitor agents triage ai-monitor incidents, wake/restart coding agents, send alerts. Never modify code.

byIntegration._doc: Each enabled integration contributes services and capabilities. Turning an integration off in agents.json removes both.

telegram._doc: Telegram bot is configured under agent.telegram, not as a service. Entry exists for symmetry.
